create_embedder_from_config: create a VertexDirectEmbedder or VertexFeatureEmbedder from a CfgNode spec and embedding dimension
build_embedder_module: build an Embedder nn.Module from a Detectron2 config that registers embedders for multiple meshes
load_embedder_checkpoint: load embedder state dict from a pkl or torch checkpoint file with a configurable key prefix
forward_vertex_embeddings: produce vertex embeddings as an NxD tensor for a named mesh via the Embedder forward method
check_mesh_embeddings: check whether an Embedder has registered embeddings for a given mesh name using has_embeddings
